summary: AmeriCorps funding opportunities aim to support organizations in managing grants and enhancing the impact of their service projects. Eligible applicants include State Service Commissions, VISTA sponsors, and grantees of programs like RSVP and Foster Grandparent. Applicants must comply with requirements such as the National Service Criminal History Check and monitoring requests. Resources include pre- and post-award guidance, training, and technical assistance.
